BGAppRefreshTask.doc: An object representing a short task typically used to refresh content that’s run while the app is in the background.

BGAppRefreshTaskRequest.doc: A request to launch your app in the background to execute a short refresh task.

BGContinuedProcessingTask.doc: A task that starts in the foreground and can continue running in the background as needed.

BGContinuedProcessingTaskRequest.doc: A request for a workload that the system continues processing even if a person backgrounds the app.

BGHealthResearchTask.doc: A time-consuming, necessary processing task that runs while the app is in the background to prepare data essential to a health research study.

BGHealthResearchTaskRequest.doc: A request to launch your app in the background to execute processing for a health research study in which a user participates.

BGProcessingTask.doc: A time-consuming processing task that runs while the app is in the background.

BGProcessingTaskRequest.doc: A request to launch your app in the background to execute a processing task that can take minutes to complete.

BGTask.doc: An abstract class for the framework’s tasks.

BGTaskRequest.doc: An abstract class for representing task requests.

BGTaskScheduler.doc: A class for scheduling tasks that add background support to your app’s most critical work.

BGTaskSchedulerErrorCode.doc: An enumeration of the task scheduling errors.

-initWithIdentifier:.doc: Return a new refresh task request for the specified identifier.

-updateTitle:subtitle:.doc: Update the task title and subtitle that the system displays to a person.

-initWithIdentifier:title:subtitle:.doc: Creates an instance on behalf of the currently foregrounded app.

-initWithIdentifier:.doc: Return a new processing task request for the specified identifier.

-setTaskCompletedWithSuccess:.doc: Informs the background task scheduler that the task is complete.

-cancelTaskRequestWithIdentifier:.doc: Cancel a previously scheduled task request.

-getPendingTaskRequestsWithCompletionHan.doc: Request a list of unexecuted scheduled task requests.

-registerForTaskWithIdentifier:usingQueu.doc: Register a launch handler for the task with the associated identifier that’s executed on the specified queue.

-submitTaskRequest:completionHandler:.doc: Submits a background task request to be scheduled with a completion handler.

-submitTaskRequest:error:.doc: Submit a previously registered background task for execution.

subtitle.doc: The localized subtitle displayed to a person.

title.doc: The localized title displayed to a person.

BGContinuedProcessingTaskRequestResource.doc: Options that specify additional system resources a background task needs.

BGContinuedProcessingTaskRequestSubmissi.doc: The ways your app suggests the system handle your task’s submission under varying conditions.

requiredResources.doc: An option that indicates any special system resources that the task requires.

strategy.doc: The submission strategy for the scheduler to abide by.

subtitle.doc: The localized subtitle displayed to a person.

title.doc: The localized task title displayed to a person.

protectionTypeOfRequiredData.doc: The file protection required to access health research data relevant to complete the task.

requiresExternalPower.doc: A Boolean specifying if the processing task requires a device connected to power.

requiresNetworkConnectivity.doc: A Boolean specifying if the processing task requires network connectivity.

expirationHandler.doc: A handler called shortly before the task’s background time expires.

identifier.doc: The string identifier of the task.

earliestBeginDate.doc: The earliest date and time at which to run the task.

identifier.doc: The identifier of the task associated with the request.

BGTaskScheduler.Error.doc: The Errors for the BGTaskSchedulerError domain.

BGTaskSchedulerErrorDomain.doc: The background tasks error domain as a string.

sharedScheduler.doc: The shared background task scheduler instance.

supportedResources.doc: Additional system resources that a continuous background task can request.
